description: This file contains a PHP unit test class 'FormatWithJobTitleTest' for testing the 'FormatWithJobTitle' class within the 'OrangeHRM' Human Resource Management system. It sets up test data, and verifies that the method 'getFormattedValue' returns expected values based on employee IDs.

classes.name: FormatWithJobTitleTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing 'FormatWithJobTitle' functionality related to formatting employee job titles based on ID.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixture, loads test data from YAML file, and instantiates 'FormatWithJobTitle' object.

methods.name: testGetFormattedValue
methods.description: Contains assertions to verify 'getFormattedValue' method returns correct job title string for employee ID 1 and null for ID 4.
